Loom, measured

Every swatch is a CSS custom property from tokens.json. Marketing declares Lens tokens (--lns-*). Light is the painted theme. The dark set is declared and was not painted. The toggle previews that declared set only. Charlie Display and Charlie Text are not loaded. The real pixels are in screenshots/.

Read from loom.com on 2026-11-18, signed out. The library, the recorder, and checkout were not entered.

Colour

Painted roles from --lns-themeLight-*. The filled action is blurple #1868db.

Palette

Named Lens colours from --lns-color-*, resolved from hsla().

Typography

Charlie Display for headlines, Charlie Text for the interface. Declared heading-lg is 48px. The home h1 computed 63.269px.

Space and shape

The unit is 8px. The painted primary CTA uses a 9999px pill. Declared full radius resolves to 7992px, the same pill.
